definitions.explanation: Vegetables whose edible part grows underground, such as carrots, daikon radish, burdock root, and potatoes. A common category in Japanese cooking and nutrition.

examples.japanese: {根菜|こんさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧。
{根菜|こんさい}⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made miso soup packed with root vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{根菜|こんさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Winter is the season when simmered dishes made with root vegetables are delicious.

notes:
USAGE:
A culinary and nutritional term. Common root vegetables in Japanese cuisine include ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ (daikon radish), にんじん (carrot), ごぼう (burdock root), ⟦{里芋|さといも}→里芋：14462_satoimo⟧ (taro), and れんこん (lotus root). In traditional Japanese health beliefs, root vegetables are thought to warm the body, making them especially valued in winter cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {根菜|こんさい}{類|るい}: root vegetables (as a category)
- {根菜|こんさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered root vegetables
- {根菜|こんさい}⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧: root vegetable salad
- {根菜|こんさい}⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧: root vegetable soup
